description: Two slew limiters, two envelope generators and four button channels that send either a trigger or a fixed voltage

params.text: Chooses what that channel does: send a 1ms trigger at 10V, or toggle its output between 0V and the voltage its knob sets
Sets the voltage that channel's output carries while it is toggled on, -10V to 10V
Works that channel by hand, sending a trigger or toggling its output as the mode switch is set
Sets the time range of that envelope, with a shortest time of 0.1 seconds, 10ms or 1ms
Sets how long that glide section takes to reach a new voltage, from 0.1 seconds to 102 seconds
Sets how long that envelope takes to rise, from the shortest time of its range to a thousand times that
Sets how long that envelope takes to fall, from the shortest time of its range to a thousand times that
Bends both slopes of that envelope, logarithmic anticlockwise, straight at noon and exponential clockwise

inputs.text: A rising edge works that channel, sending a trigger or toggling its output as the mode switch is set
A rising edge starts that envelope
The voltage that glide section slews towards

outputs.text: Carries a 1ms trigger at 10V or the voltage of that channel's knob, as the mode switch is set
That envelope, rising to 10V and falling back
The slewed output of that glide section
